subject: PRIMARY DECISION: Gen3 integration order and accepted architecture
body: Primary reconciliation against main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e is complete. No production code was changed during review. Priority: P0.1 harden tokenless V3 PREWARM into exact CAS ownership (new protocol/version preferred); P0.2 add one exact cover visual-attempt owner plus one privileged fold-shader compositor; P0.3 remove DualScreen/'Both screens at once (experimental)' execution path; P1.1 move continuity-prime-once guard from PanelEngine to stable close-cycle owner; P1.2 bind presentation evidence beneath exact visual binding rather than treating requested visual as presented; P1.3 retire service-global earlyOpeningVisualStarted ownership. Accepted: authority/content/visual/presentation separation, hidden readiness vs visible demand, host-remap rebinding, right-pane geometry, V9 early inner wake and exact-cycle capture. Rejected: restoring autonomous cover PanelEngine, changing thresholds to hide latency, stale cross-cycle image substitution, keeping DualScreen experiment, preserving current tokenless V3 prewarm semantics. Full recovery artifact and SHA are stored under primary artifacts.

applies_to.package: Gen3 integration plan / no production patch yet
